name: openttd-evidence
about: Questions an agent working in this repository asks, each with the paths whose passages are the evidence (any one of them counts) or `insufficient: true` when this repository holds none. Scored by tools/research/mcp-rhai mcp-evidence --benchmark: recall@5 and MRR over the answerable questions, and how many unanswerable ones were answered `insufficient evidence`. Written before the first run (2026-11-19); a new version adds questions, it does not tune old ones to the results.

questions.q: where does the panel refuse a Prismatic directive that was not decided from a current observation
which rule forbids changing game state outside registered commands
how must an obsolete savegame field be handled
Rhai debugger breakpoint step over call stack scope
which decision put every panel event on ZeroMQ and into a DuckDB store
shared memory between scripts compare and swap revision
where is an MCP mutation's approval bound to its exact arguments
unit tests of the MCP server's approval state machine
Prismatic client loopback token Authorization header
why are duels run side by side noisy and what does a held start change
a real place from OpenStreetMap and elevation data as an OpenTTD heightmap
forbid_90_deg rail lines a train can turn on
